alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 23 at 12:05PM MST until November 23 at 6:00PM MST by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow above 9000 feet. Snow accumulations between 3 and 7
inches. Brief heavy snowfall rates could lead to localized higher
accumulations.

* WHERE...Northwest San Juan Mountains and Southwest San Juan
Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM MST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Monday evening commute. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.

alerts.description: Between US Basin Brooklyns / 825 (9 miles north of the Silverton area) and Forest Service Road 871 (Ouray) from Mile Point 80 to Mile Point 95. Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMV) must have chains or approved alternative traction devices.

alerts.title: Traction Law Code 15
alerts.description: Between US Basin Brooklyns / 825 (9 miles north of the Silverton area) and Forest Service Road 871 (Ouray) from Mile Point 80 to Mile Point 95. Passenger vehicles that are all-wheel drive (AWD) or four-wheel drive (4WD) must have winter (Mountain Snowflake icon) or mud and snow (M+S or M/S) or manufacturer rated all-weather tires with adequate tread depth of at least 3/16 of an inch. Two-wheel drive (2WD) vehicles are required to have chains or an approved traction device.

alerts.title: CO 348 Delta to Olathe Resurfacing-153339
alerts.description: Between Pea Green Cemetery Road (4 miles east of the Delta area) and Silver Street (Delta) from Mile Point 6 to Mile Point 0.3. Road construction. Width limit in effect. Width limit 11'0". Starting November 24, 2026 at 7:00AM MST until November 24, 2026 at about 6:00PM MST. Full schedule below: • November 24, 7:00AM - November 24, 6:00PM Comment: Paving operations on US 50 in downtown Delta are scheduled for spring 2027 A signed local detour will be implemented around the concrete box culvert installation at Mile point 11.5 on CO 348. Motorists can drive south on 5400 Rd. to east Easter Rd. before connecting back to CO 348 or continuing east on CO 348 to Dahlia Rd. to south 5600 Rd. to east CO 348 into Olathe. The speed limit will be reduced to 40 mph through the work zone Loads wider than 11 feet will be restricted through the work zone There will be one-lane alternating traffic throughout the course of the project on both CO 348 and US 50 through Delta. Temporary sidewalk and pedestrian crosswalk closures will be in place for concrete curb ramp replacements. Please follow all on-site signage to navigate around active construction areas. While significant delays are not expected, motorists are encouraged to account for up to 10 minutes of extra travel time when driving on CO 348. Visit COTrip.org for real-time info
